name: DropIn
description: A shared network jukebox (bitbox) server. Clients add YouTube songs to a shared playlist and everyone listens to the same synchronized stream.

scripts.build: mkdir -p bin && curl -L https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/yt-dlp -o bin/yt-dlp && chmod +x bin/yt-dlp
